column1: - `representative_id` is the reference/template enzyme the candidate was aligned to (DIAMOND
`qseqid`). It is required because a hit without its template says only "something matched":
two candidates at 40% identity to different enzymes are not the same evidence. One row per
(template, candidate) pair here; `sequence_candidates.tsv` keeps one row per candidate.
- If the candidate's own annotation is empty, join it from `source_feature_annotations.tsv`
(`scripts/merge_source_annotations.py`) before the fast path can be evaluated.
- `evidence_class` should be one of: known, ambiguous, unknown, weak, sequence_supported.
- Empty numeric fields should be left blank, not replaced with fabricated values.
- Include the exact command line in the report or in `notes`.
